scenario: 扫描后利用：外部 IP 扫描发现漏洞后植入后门

judgment.summary: Confirmed successful exploitation of SQL injection vulnerability on production legacy system resulting in webshell deployment.
evidence_chain: WAF raw_log shows sequential attack pattern ending with 'backdoor.php created' via UNION SELECT INTO OUTFILE payload.
Threat intel confirms source IP 203.0.113.40 has malicious reputation score 11 with tags 'sqli', 'webshell'.
Related alerts A17-REL-01 and A17-REL-02 corroborate scanning and SQLi attempts prior to successful upload within 48h window.
Asset info confirms destination 10.0.2.77 is production legacy system (asset_level: medium, network_zone: 生产-DMZ), not scanner/bastion/honeypot.

iocs.context: Source IP confirmed malicious by threat intel with high confidence
Deployed webshell path identified in WAF payload highlights

remediation: Immediately block external IP 203.0.113.40 at WAF/Firewall level to stop ongoing access.
Delete /var/www/html/backdoor.php on host 10.0.2.77 and verify no other persistence mechanisms exist.
Patch the SQL injection vulnerability in products.php (legacy-app-01) and implement parameterized queries.
Conduct forensic analysis on 10.0.2.77 to check for lateral movement or data exfiltration.
Notify asset owner web-legacy@company.com and update incident ticket.
